description: This file defines a DbHelper class that manages SQLite database operations for a recipe application. It includes schema creation, seeding sample categories and recipes, and provides methods for CRUD operations on recipes and categories.

classes.name: DbHelper
classes.description: A helper class that manages database creation, version management, and provides methods to operate on recipes and categories tables.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates tables 'recipes' and 'categories' and seeds initial data with sample recipes and categories.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database upgrades; currently a no-op for version 1.

methods.name: insertRecipe
methods.description: Inserts a new recipe into the database.

methods.name: getAllRecipes
methods.description: Retrieves all recipes sorted by title.

methods.name: searchRecipes
methods.description: Searches recipes matching a query in title or description.

methods.name: getRecipesByCategory
methods.description: Fetches recipes belonging to a specific category.

methods.name: getFavoriteRecipes
methods.description: Retrieves all recipes marked as favorite.

methods.name: insertRecipe (overload)
methods.description: Inserts a recipe entity into the database, returning its ID.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Sets or unsets a recipe as favorite based on ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a recipe by its ID.

methods.name: readRecipes
methods.description: Converts cursor data into a list of recipes.

methods.name: readRecipe
methods.description: Converts cursor data into a recipe entity.
